launches.title: STASIS: The WHOOP for 16B eyes
launches.tagline: Eye-tracking smart glasses that read cognitive performance, vision, and sleep with auto-adjusting lenses.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** STASIS makes smart glasses that read your eyes all day. Sensors hidden in the frame track every blink, every squint and every stare to measure your fatigue, cognitive load and sleep. The lenses tint on their own when your eyes need it. Think WHOOP, but for your eyes and we’re already HSA/FSA eligible.

<https://youtu.be/ePA2lKoQrss>

I’m Soham, cofounder of STASIS with [Neil Goradia](https://www.linkedin.com/in/neil-goradia-634a40381/). I did eye tracking research at Mayo Clinic for 3 years, built AI models to detect voice-based neurodegeneration biomarkers, and I study bioengineering at Berkeley. Neil built custom robotic arms, holds 4 IoT and hardware patents, and shipped hardware with multiple OEMs in India. We’ve been building together since the start of freshman year.

**The problem**

Your watch knows your heart rate and your ring knows your sleep. Neither one can see your eyes, and that’s where bodily fatigue, cognitive load, visual strain, and changes in circadian rhythm show up first. Your blinks slow down, your eye movements get slower, and your gaze starts to drift.

After 9+ hours on a screen, most of us just guess with our eyes. 7 in 10 americans report screen-induced headaches, dry eyes, and yet we never see the signals that came before them.

**What STASIS does**

_Acquire biodata not available in any other wearable today_\
\
6 inward facing sensors in the frame track blink rate, eye movement speed, gaze stability, the microclimate on the eye, focus distance, and blood flow at the temples.

_Understand what’s happening_

* **Fatigue and strain:** see your visual strain building in real time, before the headache and dry eyes start being felt.
* **Focus:** see when you’re mental readiness and attention is at peak, and when cognitive load is the highest.
* **Sleep:** track the evening light that hits your eyes, so you can see what’s wrecking your nights.

_Act on it_

* **Smart lenses:** the lenses tint automatically when glare or strain spikes.
* **Nudges and Insights** based on long term trends

**What we learned when Neil wore STASIS for a week**

1. His blink rate halved right before a headache started.
2. His eye speed dropped 30% below his average whenever he wasn’t at peak focus.
3. On his worst sleep nights, his eyes had taken in 12K lux hours of blue light after 10 pm.

**Built with the people who push their eyes hardest:** elite athletes across MLB, NHL and NBA, plus esports and military esports teams. Our models are trained on 550B+ eye data points and hit 90%+ accuracy on fatigue, visual strain, cognitive load and mental readiness.

**Our ask**

1. **Spend all day on a screen?** A $99 deposit holds a Founding Member pair at $299, and it’s HSA/FSA eligible. Fully refundable. Pairs ship March 2027. [wearstasis.com](http://wearstasis.com)
2. **Know a head of performance at a pro team, or someone at a sports wearable, esports org or defense tech company?** A warm intro goes a long way.
3. **Investors** who’d be willing to help us build the WHOOP for 16 billion eyes.

Email me at [soham@wearstasis.com](mailto:soham@wearstasis.com) or [grab 30 minutes here](https://calendly.com/soham-wearstasis/30min).
